title: The Cutting EDG: Week of June 7th
body:
**Highlights**
- Edgeware Runtime Upgrade 4 is merged to the Edgeware testnet aka Beresheet. 
- Grant Dever shared the summary of his [‘Edgeware Culture and Values’ survey](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1335-culture-and-values-survey-summary-and-continued-discussion).
- Drew Stone shared an [update to the Webb Mixer’s Grant](https://commonwealth.im/webb/proposal/discussion/1314-edgeware-grant-update-webb-mixer). 
- Edgeware Ecosystem through [Blockonomi’s vision](https://blockonomi.com/edgeware-guide/).
- Upcoming AMAs: [PicoSwap](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1138-introducing-picoswap-and-pico) and [AllianceBlock](https://blog.edgewa.re/allianceblock-announces-decentralized-capital-market-on-edgeware-with-unique-defi-nft-approach/).


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Webb’s public test deployment of the first mixer is live on the Edgeware testnet aka Beresheet. Read more in the [Webb’s tech update](https://www.webb.tools/blog/tech-update-1).
- Common Protocol [integrated Crust Network](https://blog.commonwealth.im/crust-integration/).


**Governance**
- The [proposal by Zien.io](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1129-proposal-bring-zien-nfts-via-whatsapp-to-edgeware) got funded by treasury for their social media-based NFT platform on Edgeware EVM is open for public voting through Referendum 42. {Referendum type: SuperMajorityApprove, Democracy Proposal ID:37, Treasury Proposal ID:32}
- During the creation of the SimpleMajorityApprove referendum, the ‘How to make it in Crypto Media - an Original Podcast Series’ proposal was accidentally passed as a Council Motion 48 {Treasury Proposal ID:33}.
